resources.string: The key of this host could not be used. Check the key in the host, or its file in Keychain.

The key of this host changed since it was saved. That happens after the server is reinstalled, but also when someone is between you and the server. If you know why it changed, remove the host from Known hosts and connect again.
The address of the host could not be found. Check the address and the network.
The host refused the connection on port %1$d. Check the port, and that the SSH server runs.
The host can not be reached from this network. Check the address, the network and any VPN.
Mosh could not start its server on the host. Install mosh on the host (like apt install mosh), or set the path of mosh-server in the host.
The mosh server did not accept its ports (%1$s). Set a port or a range like 60000:60010 in the host.
Mosh logged in, but nothing comes back over UDP. Let UDP ports %1$s in through the firewall of the host and of its network, or turn Mosh off for this host.
The program and the UDP ports of the server, like mosh-server new -p 60000:60010. The firewall of the host must let these ports in.
The mosh server command can be the program, new, and -p with a port or a range like 60000:60010
Typed in when the key asks for it
